says: What `loop` refuses of a scene, recorded from agentspecs (plans/STUDIO.md S-10).

cases.name: a scene with nobody on stage
cases.yaml:
schema: loop.scene/v1
id: probe
version: 0.0.1
name: Probe
says: probe: the scene stages nobody: it names a `team`, or writes its `cast`

cases.name: the entry is not in the cast
cases.yaml:
schema: loop.scene/v1
id: probe
version: 0.0.1
name: Probe
entry: nobody
cast:
  - member: sales
    app: sales
    role: initiator
    runs_in: runtime
    persona:
      name: Sales
says: The scene enters at 'nobody', which is not in its cast.
